docker_host.description: Docker Engine endpoint: local unix/npipe socket or ssh://username@host:port (port defaults to 22). SSH requires exactly one of ssh_password or ssh_private_key. The remote user must be able to run docker without sudo. Plaintext TCP is rejected. Host-admin capability; never a Fleet input.

ssh_password.description: SSH login password. Mutually exclusive with ssh_private_key. Write-only secret; never passed to the Runner or placed in process arguments.

ssh_private_key.description: Complete OpenSSH/PEM private key content, not a filename. Mutually exclusive with ssh_password. Written to a private temporary file for this invocation and removed afterwards.

ssh_private_key_passphrase.description: Optional passphrase for an encrypted ssh_private_key. Omit for an unencrypted key. Write-only secret.

ssh_known_hosts.description: Verified OpenSSH known_hosts entries for the SSH target. For a non-default port use [host]:port. If omitted, the Shaula service user's existing known_hosts is used. Unknown or changed host keys are rejected; verify fingerprints out of band before supplying entries.

registry_auth.description: Optional private-registry credential for image pull. Schema-sensitive: write-only plaintext stored in the immutable SQLite Revision; never enters the Runner Execution Domain.
